svg.title: EEG–VR pilot: what changed, and when
svg.desc: Full native recording extent of 1937.26 seconds. Eight named conditions use original table start/end values; spectral windows trim five seconds at both ends. The figures above the timeline are schematic state vignettes, not actual photographs or scene captures. Final-block eye state is not specified in the source label and is kept unspecified. Fixed order cannot separate scene from time.
